Name: Suzi Lee
Grade: 3
Class: 3
ID Number: 134572
Date of Issue: March 4, 2015
Valid Until: February 28, 2016
If you find this card, please return it to the teacher's office.

(<조건>
• 'who' 또는 'which' 중 하나를 사용할 것
• 'issue'를 사용하되 형태를 변형할 것
• 'the student identification card'를 사용할 것

→ March 4, 2015 is __________.

(2) <조건>
• 'when' 또는 'where' 중 하나를 사용할 것
• 'valid', 'will', 'any more'를 사용할 것

→ February 28, 2016 is __________.

(3) <조건>
주어진 단어를 모두 사용할 것
주어진 단어: you / where / the card / can

→ The teacher's office is the place __________.

subParts.answer: the date when the student identification card was issued
the day when the card will not be valid any more
where you can return the card
